A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''[[Gender/Legends|woman]]''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the mother of [[Kira Carsen]]. She and [[Kira Carsen's father|her husband]] had their child on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but as a young child Carsen was taken by the servants of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to become one of the [[Children of the Emperor]].
